data.name: Description
data.value: The name, logo and colors of your website. Empty colors use the selected theme. These settings apply to the whole website.

data.name: LogoDescription
data.value: An HTTPS image URL or a path on this website, such as /images/logo.png. Empty keeps the text brand.

data.name: AccentDescription
data.value: Hex color such as #D9B773 for highlights and buttons; empty uses the theme.

data.name: BackgroundDescription
data.value: Website background as #RRGGBB; empty uses the theme.

data.name: PanelDescription
data.value: Content card background as #RRGGBB; empty uses the theme.

data.name: TextDescription
data.value: Main text color as #RRGGBB. Choose a color clearly readable against your panels; empty uses the theme.

data.name: ColorValidation
data.value: Enter a color as #RRGGBB, such as #D9B773, or leave it empty.

data.name: LogoLengthValidation
data.value: The logo address must contain at most {1} characters.

data.name: LogoFormatValidation
data.value: Use an HTTPS image address or a path on this website, or leave it empty.
